anchors.prompt: Create a new photo: A bright dining room of a modest family home next to the kitchen: a wooden table with a light blue checked tablecloth; on it the small dark amber glass bottle with a dropper, a small box of adhesive bandages, a folded napkin, a glass of water and a fruit bowl with oranges; behind him a window with white curtains, framed family photos on the wall, a wooden sideboard with plates. The doctor sits at the table, his left forearm resting palm-up on the tablecloth, looking at the viewer mid-sentence, friendly. Medium shot, waist up, eye level, from about two meters. The man is the doctor of the input image (a close-up of his real face): EXACTLY that face — same face shape, eyes, nose, eyebrows, dark curly hair with a little grey, short salt-and-pepper beard, same age (about 40) — do not make him younger or more handsome. He wears blue medical scrubs with short sleeves, a black stethoscope around his neck and a black smartwatch on his left wrist. A casual home video frame, ordinary, candid.
Same place, same framing and same light: he sits at the table holding the amber dropper bottle, his left forearm resting palm-up on the tablecloth.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the inner side of his left forearm resting palm-up on the blue checked tablecloth; his right index fingertip holds a single golden drop of oil just above the skin. Only arm and hand, no face —  Same place, same light and same objects as the first image, but the camera is now VERY CLOSE: this detail fills the whole frame.
Same close-up: a small glossy round spot of oil spread on the inner forearm skin, the fingertip lifting away.
Same place, same framing and same light: he sits holding up his left forearm toward the camera, showing the small glossy spot.
Same place, same framing and same light: he holds up his forearm with a small adhesive bandage on the inner side, smiling.
Same place, same framing and same light: he sits with a serious face, hands open over the table, shaking his head gently.
Same place, same framing and same light: he holds one finger near the outer corner of his eye, eyebrows drawn together, warning.
Same place, same framing and same light: he shows his flat palm like a stop sign toward the viewer, firm but kind.
Same place, same framing and same light: he stands by the hallway door on the right holding the amber bottle, looking back at the viewer over his shoulder.

clips.text: Prueba de parche. Ya sé, suena aburrido. Pero el laurel es una planta aromática, y a algunas personas les da alergia. Así de simple.
clips.action: Seated at the table, he talks with a small honest shrug, then picks up the amber bottle and shows it.

clips.text: Una gota del aceite, en la parte de adentro del antebrazo. Aquí, donde la piel es finita. La extiendes un poquito, en un círculo chiquito.
clips.action: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the FOREARM and HAND ONLY: the fingertip touches the inner forearm, spreads the golden drop of oil in a tiny circle and lifts away.

clips.text: Y esperas veinticuatro horas. Sin lavar esa zona, si puedes. Yo le pongo una curita encima, para acordarme, mira.
clips.action: He takes an adhesive bandage from the box, peels it and sticks it over the spot on his inner forearm, then shows it to the camera.

clips.text: Si al otro día está roja, te pica o te arde, no lo uses en la cara. Lavas con agua y jabón, y listo: ese aceite no es para ti.
clips.action: With a serious face he mimes itching on the forearm, grimaces, then mimes washing with soap and shakes his head.

clips.text: Y si está todo normal, bien, ya puedes usarlo en la cara. Pero ojo: nunca en el contorno de los ojos, ni en los párpados.
clips.action: He nods, relieved, then points at the skin around his own eyes and wags his finger 'no'.

clips.text: Ni sobre piel lastimada, ni sobre una herida, ni después de quemarte con el sol. Y si un día arde, lavas y suspendes. Así, derecho.
clips.action: He counts the warnings on his fingers one by one, then makes a firm stop gesture with his palm.

clips.text: Ahora sí, la parte que casi todos hacen mal sin saberlo: cómo se aplica. Porque no es untarse y ya. Vamos al baño, frente al espejo.
clips.action: He stands up from the chair, takes the amber bottle and walks toward the hallway door on the right, glancing back at the viewer.
